individualMethodAdjudication.rationaleDe: Beobachtung und physikalische Erklärung zu unterscheiden liefert die vorhandene Grundlage für die Funktion von Modellen. Das Ziel wird in der Methodenfolge vor dem Modellziel zugänglich; die kanonische Voraussetzung zur regulären Orientierung bleibt unverändert.

Physikalische Quellen geben Größen, Einheiten und Bezugsbedingungen an. Das vorhandene Verständnisprofil der Informationsauswertung verlangt deren Vergleich ausdrücklich. Das bestehende SI-Ziel ermöglicht diese Grundlage, ohne zusätzliche astrophysikalische Sachinhalte oder neue SI-Kompetenzen zu erfinden. In BY SekII wird nur diese belegte Auslassung unmittelbar vor dem bereits vorhandenen Quellenziel ergänzt.

Die vorhandene Modellkompetenz klärt die Rolle physikalischer Modelle beim Abgleich von Quellen mit physikalischen Kenntnissen. Sie baut weiterhin auf Beobachtung und Erklärung auf. Die Modellbeispiele bleiben Beispiele; die Platzierung führt keine Pflicht zur Beherrschung aller einzelnen Beispielmodelle ein.

Die beiden bereits sichtbaren Astro-Ziele verlangen die zielgerichtete Auswertung beziehungsweise kritische Beurteilung von Quellen. Eine offene, ausschließlich versteckte Quellenkompetenz wäre kein lernbarer Zwischenschritt. Deshalb wird das vorhandene allgemein formulierte Quellenziel in denselben synthetischen Astrophysik-Fokus aufgenommen, mit unveränderten Modell- und SI-Voraussetzungen.

sourceAndScopeEvidence.supports: Existing source extraction explicitly combines celestial-body classification with targeted source research, and open cosmology with judging physical correctness, trustworthiness and relevance. This justifies the source-method connection; it does not establish new normative coverage for other jurisdictions.
Current individual mapping decisions co-bind each held astronomy goal with the existing source-evaluation competency. No mappings or retained source extraction were changed.

Existing understandingEvidence compares source statements, units and conditions against physical knowledge. This supports retaining the current SI and model prerequisites. This receipt does not reapprove that resolution for a changed projected context.

Projection roles are authored scope semantics. prerequisiteOnly goals retain global mastery for prerequisite checks but never enter the learner-facing target frontier. SekI tags do not themselves decide projection roles. Target additions here are explicit scope authoring and must be described as such.

routeAndFocusBoundaries.regularOrientation: The existing subject orientation is already a target in every astronomy view. It is not duplicated in the new methods folder. The proposed method sequence starts after the learner completed that regular orientation.
routeAndFocusBoundaries.repairedAstroFocus: In the 56 affected views, both astronomy targets and all four method targets are descendants of the same existing synthetic Astrophysik structure. After normal orientation, its method branch can be learned within that authored focus. Each astronomy target still requires its unchanged separate subject-matter prerequisite.
routeAndFocusBoundaries.narrowGoalFocus: The backend scope is the selected focus plus contains descendants, not automatic requires closure. Selecting a single astronomy goal, the methods subfolder alone or the canonical Astrophysik cluster ID does not necessarily equal selecting the authored synthetic Astrophysik structure. These different focus choices retain their existing runtime semantics.
routeAndFocusBoundaries.allZeroNarrowFocus: A brand-new learner who directly selects a narrow Astro focus with the external global orientation still uncompleted is not claimed to have a fully cold-start-safe strict route. getRequiredOrientationGoals itself only selects orientation inside the current scope. Normal subject entry resolves the orientation before this repair's method sequence.
routeAndFocusBoundaries.bavaria: BY SekII already places source evaluation in Ph11.1 and observation/model methods in Ph11.4. SI is inserted immediately before source evaluation in Ph11.1 with a single target occurrence. The complete method chain is available in the broad SekII/subject focus. A narrow Ph11.1 or later Astro focus retains the existing need for prior or separately learned observation/model competencies; their placements were not duplicated or moved.
routeAndFocusBoundaries.rolePromotion: The eight RP/TH prerequisiteOnly references become targets at the view level, not only locally inside one branch. Other focus selections obey normal backend target-scope behavior. In optimistic rich-frontier mode, an out-of-focus target prerequisite may be ignored; prerequisiteOnly supports were previously always checked. No runtime behavior was changed or certified beyond the existing fixtures.
routeAndFocusBoundaries.noFullCurriculumClaim: This receipt addresses the source-method chain for the two specified astronomy goals. It does not certify that every other prerequisite chain in these curricula is complete, nor that every possible narrow learner focus is independently closed.
